info.description: API for teacher availability management and bookings
info.title: Converge API

get.description: Returns all active teachers with their weekly availability slots, grouped by teacher

post.description: Replaces all existing availability for a teacher with the provided weekly schedule (full replace, not merge). Rejects overlapping slots within the same day.

get.description: Admin sees all bookings; a student sees only their own; a parent sees their students' bookings.

post.description: Evaluates each preferred_slot independently and returns per-slot results with either an exact_match or alternatives.
Creates the actual booking in the database after the client selects a result from the evaluate endpoint.

delete.description: Deletes a confirmed booking by ID. Returns 404 if not found.

get.description: Returns all branches ordered by id

patch.description: Sets how many bookings a branch can hold concurrently. 0 means unlimited/unenforced.

get.description: Returns the commute time in minutes. Without query params, returns the default commute time. With both source_branch and destination_branch, returns 0 when they are equal, otherwise the default.
get.summary: Get commute time between two branches

patch.description: Sets the commute time in minutes applied between different branches. Must be non-negative.

post.description: Verifies a user's name and password and returns a JWT access token plus the user.

get.summary: List all parents with their students (admin only)
List a parent's linked students (admin only)

post.summary: Link a student to a parent (admin only)

delete.summary: Unlink a student from a parent (admin only)

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a user with a unique name, a bcrypt-hashed password, and the given role.

get.description: Returns all subjects ordered by id
Returns teachers ordered by name. Filter by status (active|deactivated|all, default all). Optionally filter by subject_id, which returns active teachers only and ignores status.

parameters.description: Filter by subject ID (active teachers only)
parameters.name: subject_id

post.description: Adds a new teacher with name, email, and gender

patch.description: Sets a teacher's gender to male, female, or lgbtq+
Sets a teacher's status to active or deactivated

student_ids.description: StudentIDs links a parent to the students they guard. Required when role is parent, ignored otherwise.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT from /login.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
